Name: Query Vertex AI RAG
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Queries a Vertex AI RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Corpus to retrieve context-rich semantic search results. The action resolves the target RAG corpus ID, executes a vector search with user-configured limits (Top K), and  extracts relevant historical cases, runbooks, or policy documentation. Structured findings are loaded directly into programmatic JSON outputs for downstream playbook logic and displayed in a dedicated "RAG Search Results" tab on the Case Wall. Built with strict credential checks and fail-fast validation to ensure stable platform execution.
